_doc: Campaign-state schema v1. Read at the start of every cycle by the orchestrator. All fields are required unless marked optional. Append-only campaign-specific fields go under `campaign_specific`.
current_phase: intent | survey | build | run | analyze | wrap
_doc_campaign_specific: Campaign-specific extension fields go here. Examples: swept parameter range, reference-model checksums, target study tag, custom convergence thresholds. Do not put generic state here.
